doHardWork().notice: Claims and liquidates 1inch into underlying, and then invests all underlying.

investAllUnderlying().notice: Invests all the underlying into the pool that mints crops (1inch)

salvage(address,address,uint256).notice: Salvages a token. We should not be able to salvage underlying.

setSell(bool).notice: Can completely disable claiming 1inch rewards and selling. Good for emergency withdraw in the simplest possible way.

setSellFloorAndSlippages(uint256,uint256.notice: Sets the minimum amount of 1inch needed to trigger a sale.

withdrawAllToVault().notice: Withdraws all the underlying tokens to the pool.

withdrawToVault(uint256).notice: Withdraws the underlying tokens to the pool in the specified amount.

userdoc.notice: This strategy is for the 1INCH/BNB LP token on 1inch
